name: tf-snag-install
description: Downloads the tf-snag CLI from a GitHub release and puts it on PATH for the rest of the job.
helpMarkDown: [Documentation](https://github.com/wes-key/tf-snag/blob/main/extension/tasks/README.md). Releases are private, so `githubToken` needs read-only **Contents** on the repository.
author: wes-key

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: A release tag (`v0.1.2`) to pin, or `latest`. Pinning is worth it once a pipeline is in use: a report format change should be something you adopt, not something that lands overnight.

inputs.name: includePrerelease
inputs.label: Include pre-releases
inputs.helpMarkDown: Off by default: `latest` takes the newest stable release. Tick it to take the newest tag of any kind, including `-dev.N` / `-rc.N` pre-releases.

inputs.name: repository
inputs.label: GitHub repository
inputs.helpMarkDown: `owner/repo` to download the release from. Change this only for a fork.

inputs.name: githubToken
inputs.label: GitHub token
inputs.helpMarkDown: A GitHub token with read-only **Contents** on the repository, e.g. `$(GITHUB_TOKEN)` from a secret pipeline variable. Required while the repository is private.

outputVariables.name: tfSnagPath
outputVariables.description: Full path of the downloaded tf-snag binary.

outputVariables.name: tfSnagVersion
outputVariables.description: Release tag that was installed, e.g. v0.1.2.
